children.value: To parallelize the trapezoidal integration with MPI, we can divide the integration range among multiple processors. Each processor computes the integral over a smaller sub-range, and then the results from all processors are combined to obtain the final integral. This approach leverages the distributed processing power of the cluster to speed up the computation.
